title: Subscription status is clearer in Enter
summary:
A maintenance-minded day: clearer subscription details, a home for terms and privacy, and some quieter plumbing fixes.

Enter’s tier panel now shows the active Polar subscription’s product name and daily Pollen, or says when no subscription is active. Users with an assigned tier but no active subscription get an activation button, and the refill countdown follows 24-hour cycles from the subscription start.

Enter now has a /terms page with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy documents. The dashboard links to it, the main site’s footer points there, and Enter’s Pollen FAQ renders directly from Markdown.

Enter’s image and text upstream URLs now use their origin hosts, and the image proxy logs error responses. The tier panel’s badges were restyled, and a missing comma in the main site’s creative projects list was fixed.
